refnamediv.refpurpose: Deterministically derive the key pair from a single key

refentry.refsect1:
&reftitle.description;
stringsodium_crypto_sign_seed_keypair #[\SensitiveParameter]stringseed
Uses the seed to derive the public key, and returns a keypair whose secret key is the seed followed by the public key.
The same seed always gives the same keypair. The seed is not salted nor stretched: to generate a keypair from a password, derive a 32-byte seed from it first, for example with sodium_crypto_pwhash.
